{{Quote|Dr. Oggrurobb's [sic] latest masterpiece combines Zakuul firepower with Republic surveillance technology to create a deadly roving command headquarters.|Strategic Command Walker description|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Strategic Command Walker''' was a two-legged combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]] designed by [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] for use by [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Cartel Specials" /> The walker combined [[Zakuul]] weaponry&mdash;two side-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a smaller, chin-mounted laser cannon&mdash;with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] surveillance technology to form an effective mobile command headquarters.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Strategic Command Walker was released on [[April 4]], [[2017]]<ref name="Cartel Specials" /> as part of the 5.1 patch for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', costing 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] or 1,500 Cartel Coins.<ref name="TOR" /> The walker is part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="Patch 5.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/12317/game-update-5.1-defend-throne|text=Game Update 5.1: Defend the Throne Patch Notes}}</ref>
